thread:
Rhea (CS): quick synthesis from 6 onboarding + renewal check calls this week. dropping a compact capture of asks that look like renewal levers or onboarding blockers.
Tom (CS): paste the short list pls, i'll mark urgent renewal flags.
Rhea (CS): CSV excerpt (trimmed):
```
acct,ask,type,impact,notes
meridian,request-tags,feature,high,needs arbitrary tags persisted for internal chargeback
polaris,per-route-ledger,feature,high,finance needs per-route CSV for reconciliation
argo,invite-templates,feature,medium,bulk invite + role presets for teams
```
Tom (CS): Meridian + Polaris both called out as renewal-impact in calls. Polaris finance team insisted on per-route ledger before they expand pilots.
Aisha (PM): request-tags vs per-route-ledger: do we need both or can one solve both workflows?
Rhea (CS): Meridian wants freeform tags on each request (e.g., project=alpha,cost-center=42) and those tags to show up in exports and billing records. Polaris wants a per-route aggregation for the last 30/90 days with estimated cost columns. overlapping but distinct.
Ken (Eng): tech notes: tags: add small JSON metadata field to accepted request payloads, persist with usage events, and surface in export pipeline. ledger: aggregate by route key and run daily job. rough effort: tags spike 3d + 4d dev work; ledger spike 1d + 3d dev work.
Tom (CS): can we ship ledger CSV quickly as a CS pilot to Polaris? that seems high-impact and low-friction.
Aisha (PM): agree. propose: 1) per-route ledger CSV pilot this sprint for top 3 renewal-risk accounts, 2) start tags spike in parallel for a Q2 roll.
billing-bot: created jira CS-6120 "per-route ledger export (CS pilot)" assigned to @ken.
Rhea (CS): adding customer quotes to CS-6120: "Finance can't reconcile charges without a per-route ledger." and "We need a CSV we can drop into our cost model."
Ken (Eng): i'll spike the ledger export today and post a sample CSV schema in the ticket. preliminary ACs: 1) CSV includes route, date, request_count, token_count, cost_estimate; 2) supports time-window (30/90 days); 3) signed URL for download; 4) org-scoped auth.
Aisha (PM): for tags: can we scope MVP to accepted request header + one persistent field in usage export? keep it simple.
Ken (Eng): yes. tags MVP ACs: 1) accept metadata headers in requests, 2) persist to usage events, 3) include tags in export, 4) max tag size/whitelist for safety.
Tom (CS): Rhea, i'll draft outreach to Meridian + Polaris offering pilot windows and timeline (CSV pilot ETA: 5 business days).
Rhea (CS): please include staging link + ask if they'd like a brief walkthrough once sample is ready. also flag renewal team.
billing-bot: added comment to CS-6120 with sample CSV columns and estimated delivery: 5d.
Ken (Eng): will follow up with a short PR + smoke tests for aggregation accuracy.
Aisha (PM): I'll log both initiatives in the product backlog and tag as renewal-impact. Let's recon in 2 days for status.
Tom (CS): noted. adding two short quotes to the tags ticket too: "We Need tags to map usage to internal cost centers" 12 - Meridian.
Rhea (CS): thanks team. if pilot goes well we can convert ledger to automated exports and fold tags into the UI for easier adoption. :sparkles:
